DUAL-STANDARD POWER SUPPLY PlatiGemini PLATINUM ATX 3.1 & ATX12VO POWER SUPPLY
Red Dot Design Award 2024
As the world's first power supply to integrate seamlessly with both Intel ATX 3.1 and ATX12VO standards, the PlatiGemini is recognized with the Red Dot award in the Red Dot Award: Product Design 2024!
LEARN MORE FIND MORE AWARDS
WORLD'S FIRST DUAL-STANDARD POWER SUPPLY
*Based on Intel psuselector-20240301
The PlatiGemini is an 80 PLUS® PLATINUM efficiency certified power supply supporting both Intel ATX 3.1 and ATX12VO standards simultaneously in a single model. The dual-standard ensures a smooth transition to the next generation of computing with a significant improvement in power efficiency and reduction in power consumption under low load. The PlatiGemini is designed to satisfy a variety of applications and industry fields including enterprises with high power consumption needs and creators in filmmaking, video editing, photography, game design, animation, and product design.  To meet evolving needs from the present to the future, the PlatiGemini is packed with ENERMAX's cutting-edge technology, seamlessly integrating Intel ATX 3.1 and ATX12VO standards that painlessly switch between different specifications with motherboards compliant. It also boasts a native 600W 12V-2x6 cable, tailored to meet the evolving demands of high-end graphics cards both now and in the future.
SOLUTION FOR HIGH-END DESKTOP
"The high-end desktop market requires power supplies with higher power levels than the typical mainstream market." - Intel ATX12VO (12V Only) Desktop Power Supply Design GuideThe primary feature of the ATX12VO standard is the elimination of the 3.3V and 5V rails present in traditional ATX power supplies. The PlatiGemini represents a shift towards more efficient power delivery mechanisms in high-end desktops, achieving higher overall efficiency levels with unparalleled quality and technology.
THE EVOLUTION OF THE POWER SUPPLY TECHNOLOGY
The PlatiGemini stands out with its unparalleled versatility by accommodating both 24-pin mainstream motherboards and 10-pin eco-friendly 12VO motherboards, which ensures adaptability to any current or future tech needs, bridging the gap between different specifications.
CONVERT 12VO POWER DIRECTLY
When using the 10-pin power connector, the power delivery is consolidated into a single 12V rail directly without any additional adaptor, which minimizes power loss and potential damage risks to your system.
EXCEPTIONAL ADAPTABILITY WITH 600W 12V-2X6 CABLE
Compliants with both Intel ATX 3.1 and ATX12VO specifications, the PlatiGemini is equipped with a native 600W 12V-2x6 cable to unleash the best performance of your high-end graphic cards while ensuring seamless compatibility with modern hardware configurations.
ECO-CONSCIOUS WITH ENERGY-SAVING APPLIANCES
The PlatiGemini emphasizes the ECO-conscious principle and prioritizes energy conservation by directly converting voltage through sophisticated circuit design and engineering, which aims to minimize electronic waste and power loss during conversion.
SUSTAINABILITY AT ITS CORE
As the Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principle becomes a vital concept, The PlatiGemini is specifically designed to align with the efficiency standards mandated by energy regulations such as ENERGY STAR* and CEC PC Computers, ensuring optimal performance and adherence to environmentally conscious practices.
80 PLUS® PLATINUM EFFICIENCY
The PlatiGemini is 80 PLUS® PLATINUM certified with up to 94% efficiency on a typical load and up to 76% efficiency at 2% load. ENERMAX is devoted to creating a greener environment by building a high-efficiency power supply with less energy waste, and the PlatiGemini is competent for delivering unprecedented high-performance conversion while reducing unnecessary heat to improve reliability and longer lifespan for your system.
TOP-TIER PERFORMANCE
UP TO 235%POWER EXCURSION
Accommodating power surges of up to 235%, the PlatiGemini is capable of handling over 2.35X its rated wattage for short durations. This feature meets the power demands of high-end graphics cards, ensuring system stability by preventing power fluctuations and potential PC crashes.
100%JAPANESE CAPACITORS
The PlatiGemini incorporates 100% industrial-grade Japanese capacitors with high-quality materials and manufacturing processes, ensuring stable and consistent performance.
6-POLEMOTOR
Equipped with a 6-pole motor with a 3-phase fan to provide minimal vibration, low power consumption, and an exceptionally smooth operation with low noise.
INDUSTRIAL DUAL-BALLBEARING
The PlatiGemini boasts an industrial-grade dual-ball bearing fan, minimizing friction for optimized performance, stability, and exceptional quality. The advantage enhances the unit's lifespan and maximizes system performance for demanding needs.
DUST-FREE ROTATION (D.F.R.) TECHNOLOGY
The power supply fan boasts ENERMAX’s patented Dust-free Rotation (D.F.R.) self-cleaning technology with a power-on activated switch next to the power switch, enhancing system longevity by minimizing dust accumulation inside the power supply. The D.F.R. function can blow away dust through instant reversal of centrifugal force when it is activated, making the maintenance so easy without disassembling your power supply.
2 WAYS TO ACTIVATE D.F.R. FUNCTION
POWER ON
Upon powering on your PC, the D.F.R. function will be activated automatically for 20 seconds. The fan will then turn back to the regular anticlockwise direction for another 20 seconds and stop spinning until you reach 60% workload thanks to semi-fanless control technology.
D.F. (DUST-FREE) SWITCH
Press the D.F. switch on the power switch side to initiate the D.F.R. function whenever you want. There are two types of way for cleaning paired with semi-fanless control technology.
√ Power Supply under 60% Load & Under-Temperature (=Fan is not spinning)
Press the switch then the fan will spin clockwise for 20 seconds and turn back to anticlockwise direction for another 20 seconds then it will stop entirely.
√ Power Supply over 60% Load or Over-Temperature (=Fan is spinning)
If you press the D.F. switch while the fan is spinning, the fan will stop immediately and start to spin clockwise for 20 seconds, it will then turn back to the anticlockwise direction.
OPTIMAL SEMI-FANLESS CONTROL TECHNOLOGY
The built-in optimal semi-fanless technology allows the fan to remain stopped until you reach 60% working load or over-temperature, the fanless mode will improve the overall system acoustics by reducing fan noise when the cooling demand is low while reducing the power consumption and operating costs over time.
PREMIUM MESH-SLEEVED CABLES
The power supply cables have been upgraded to premium mesh-sleeved cables to bring you better cable routing with their soft and bendable points for remarkable cable management. The included 27 pcs cable comb kit keeps your cables in good management and in good order.
HEAVY-DUTY INDUSTRIAL-GRADE PROTECTIONS

Notice:
For users looking to put in a high-end, power-demanding GPU, please plug in the 12+4P / 6P / 6+2P PCIe connector(s) from your ENERMAX power supply to the GPU properly. This will prevent the motherboard from overloading and possibly causing any damage to your system, including your ENERMAX power supply. Once this occurs, it will be treated as improper system configuration, and any damage caused to the power supply, as a result, will not be covered under ENERMAX manufacturer’s warranty. Please refer to your motherboard & GPU’s user manuals to configure your system properly to prevent the motherboard from overloading and causing any damage to your system and your power supply.
The modular cables in the box are all compatible with your newly purchased power supply. Please only use the modular cables provided in your ENERMAX power supply package. Do NOT use other modular cables to prevent pin configuration damage to your system and your power supply.
Info for the rated current of the DC cables: The safety current is 6A per single DC wire. Please note that overloading may cause the connectors or wires to meltdown and could void the warranty.
